title: Local car studio verified: cabin, moving panels and 12 systems
summary: Verified the locally rendered sports sedan, cockpit and opening panels, multilingual learning, progress persistence and current app history.

changes.detail: Corrected cockpit camera clearance after screenshot inspection, reset panel state and mobile framing. Made Isolate available from initial load, added open/close labels and moved cabin/parts controls directly below the viewer.
Updated studio regression checks for the local assembly and the live app; documented original educational geometry and exact-BMW limitations.

validation.name: Bundle, types and focused lint
validation.detail: npm run studio:build; npm run typecheck; focused ESLint for local-car.ts, viewer.ts and runtime.ts.

validation.name: Focused regression tests
validation.detail: 15 tests passed across car-studio, change-history, change-history-interaction, progress and more-screen.

validation.name: Actual 3D model and visual checks
validation.detail: local-car-smoke.cjs passed: zero external requests; 482 unique meshes, 157660 triangles, 12 systems; animated hinge open/close, initial Isolate button, cockpit, modes, paint, raycast selection, pause/disposal and 320/390/844px layouts. Inspected desktop/mobile/open/cockpit/interior images.

validation.name: Multilingual studio and GLB regression
validation.detail: car-studio-smoke.cjs passed English/French/Darija learning, quiz/progress, guided tour, simulation and layout checks; GLB fixture load/select/orbit/zoom/pinch/pan/paint/X-ray/explode/disposal/recovery checks passed.

validation.name: Live app integration
validation.detail: car-studio-app-smoke.cjs on localhost:8082 passed More to Studio, current local canvas, saved/restored progress, unchanged course completion and visible Change History. Synthetic auth only.

validation.name: Remaining limitations
validation.detail: No Android/iOS physical-device or GPU-performance measurements, no production deployment. Original illustrative sports sedan geometry is not an exact licensed BMW model or repair reference.
